import_contract.occupancy: 0..1 numeric fractions or explicit percent strings, normalized once
import_contract.ambiguous: Bare values above 1 and explicit percentages above 100%, invalid formulas/dates/vendors, and duplicate departure identities quarantine the entire workbook before run writes or missing flags; missing mandatory Date/Capacity headers and malformed or uncached date formulas block all run writes/missing markers
import_contract.blanks: Null remains no-run; zero remains an observed empty load; workbook export preserves null
import_contract.identity: Explicit labels are reserved across all active mapped sheets before unlabeled assignment; alias-sheet order cannot collide with explicit identities. Identical reimports are stable. Unlabeled row rearrangements still cannot prove historical departure identity.
import_contract.provenance: Original cells/formulas, number formats, raw date, workbook epoch, sheet/row and SHA-256 retained in prior_values for accepted rows; quarantine report retains rejected evidence
import_contract.history: No deletions; full prior actual history retained without the former 25-entry truncation; conflicting source-owned history blocks writes; no auto-retraining on manual import

scoring.legacy: Existing mean departure occupancy per route-day retained for comparable finite records
scoring.strict: Conservative timing cohort for one recorded departure: known cutoff time and timezone, finite 0..1 values, no missing-from-sheet flag, and the latest possible America/Chicago forecast-day instant at or before the earliest applicable configured cutoff bound. This does not independently validate legacy actual units or departure completeness.
scoring.denominator: All in-scope route-days with non-null finite actuals; exclusions include no forecast; metrics denominator is eligible route-days and coverage separately discloses all actual route-days
scoring.timing: Full Central source-day bounds are compared with real route-zone cutoff instants; seconds are retained. Missing time/zone, unsupported zones and DST gaps are excluded. DST folds and overlapping feeder rules use the earliest valid cutoff instant. Historical cutoff changes remain unverified.
scoring.units: Mean occupancy and summed truck equivalents displayed separately. Ambiguous historical actuals have no fabricated total truck equivalents.
